name: mount-heights-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `mountHeights` flag (simple tier): places a wall-mounted mirror, opens its inspector, verifies the one-tap 'Standard heights' preset row renders and clicking a preset commits the exact height to the item's props, then verifies the preset row (only) disappears when the flag is forced off and reappears when it's forced back on.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-mirror-placed
steps.failMessage: wall-mirror was not added to the store

steps.name: select-mirror
steps.eval: (function(){ const it = window.__store.getState().items.find(i => i.defId === 'wall-mirror'); window.__store.getState().selectItem(it.id); window.__mirrorId = it.id; })()

steps.name: inspector-open
steps.failMessage: Inspector panel did not open for the selected wall-mirror

steps.name: open-properties-section
steps.eval: (function(){ const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button.insp-sec-toggle')].find(el => el.textContent.trim().startsWith('Properties')); if (!h) throw new Error('Properties disclosure header not found; headers: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button.insp-sec-toggle')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|')); h.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-presets-visible-default
steps.failMessage: Standard-heights preset row not found with mountHeights flag on (default)

steps.name: click-vanity-preset
steps.eval: (function(){ const group = document.querySelector("[role='group'][aria-label='Standard heights']"); const btn = [...group.querySelectorAll('button.chip')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('1.35')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Over vanity 1.35 m preset chip not found; chips: ' + [...group.querySelectorAll('button.chip')].map(b=>b.textContent).join('|')); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-mount-height-committed
steps.failMessage: mountHeight prop was not updated to 1.35 after clicking the preset chip

steps.name: assert-presets-hidden-when-off
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector("[role='group'][aria-label='Standard heights']")) throw new Error('Standard-heights preset row still visible with mountHeights flag OFF'); })()

steps.name: assert-hang-height-field-still-present
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Hang height')) throw new Error('Hang height numeric field disappeared entirely (should stay — only the preset row is flag-gated): ' + t); })()

steps.name: assert-presets-visible-again
steps.failMessage: Standard-heights preset row did not reappear after re-enabling mountHeights
